Who we are

Sydney renovators who handle it all.

Home Renovation Masters is a Sydney renovation company with more than 50 years of combined experience across the trades. We take on home renovations in Sydney for homeowners, from a single painting or plastering job to a full house renovation, and we work six days a week.

Most Sydney home renovations involve more than one trade. A kitchen and bathroom renovation in Sydney usually needs carpentry, plumbing, electrical work, waterproofing, tiling and painting, all in the right order. As home renovation specialists in Sydney, we plan that order with you and coordinate the crew, so you deal with one team instead of chasing six.

Homeowners usually compare several renovation builders and home renovation companies in Sydney before they choose. Our advice is simple: talk to the people who will actually work in your home, ask for a written scope and quote, and check the licences behind every trade. You can see how a job runs from first visit to handover in our renovation process, or meet the Home Renovation Masters team.

WALLS & SURFACES

Walls with texture and depth

Fluted tiles catch the light. Large-format porcelain gives stone-look walls a calmer finish with fewer grout lines.

What to ask your tradesperson

Which finish suits a feature wall, splashback or wet area? Ask about cleaning, joins and the waterproofing behind the finish.

FLOORS & FINISHES

One floor that ties rooms together

Carry a warm oak tone through the living areas. Compare the feel of engineered timber with hybrid or vinyl options for a busy household.

What to ask your tradesperson

Bring samples home. Compare them in daylight, and ask what suits your subfloor, moisture exposure, pets and maintenance needs.

SMART HOMES & ELECTRICAL

A home that adjusts to your day

Try one-touch lighting scenes, a soft night path to the bathroom, and connected controls for lighting, blinds or air conditioning.

What to ask your tradesperson

Discuss what can still work from a wall switch, how devices work together and what the electrician needs to plan before walls are closed.

Think ahead while the walls are open

Make room for what’s next.

Not ready for an EV charger or smarter energy controls? Ask what’s worth allowing for now and what can wait until later.

What counts as like-for-like?

We review the same work, specifications and inclusions on the same terms. Differences in exclusions, site conditions, timing or warranties can affect the comparison. We’ll explain any difference and confirm the offer in writing after checking the quote.

Older homes, strata buildings and newer houses each bring their own renovation questions, and we plan for them from the first visit.

Questions homeowners ask

Renovation questions, answered.

Straight answers to what Sydney homeowners ask us before a renovation starts.

What does Home Renovation Masters do?

Home Renovation Masters is a Sydney home renovation team with more than 50 years of combined experience. We renovate kitchens, bathrooms and laundries, and we handle the individual trades as well: painting, plastering, carpentry, framing, tiling, flooring, waterproofing, plumbing, electrical, air conditioning, landscaping and cleaning. You can bring us one job or the whole house.

Can you do a single trade job, or only full renovations?

Both. Many homeowners start with one job, such as a ceiling repair, a repaint or new flooring, and come back for a bigger renovation later. When a project needs several trades, we plan the order of work and coordinate them, so you have one point of contact from the first visit to handover.

How much does a home renovation cost in Sydney?

It depends on the size of the space, the finishes you choose, how much plumbing and electrical work moves, and whether any walls or structure change. You get a written, itemised quote after we see the job. Our home renovation cost guide explains what drives the price before you ask for a quote.

How long does a renovation take?

Timing depends on the scope. A repaint or a set of ceiling repairs can take days, while a bathroom or kitchen renovation runs for weeks once trades, waterproofing and finishes are included. Your quote comes with a written schedule. For bathrooms, see how long a bathroom renovation takes.

Do I need council approval to renovate in NSW?

Not always. Many minor renovations and low-impact works in NSW are exempt development and need no planning or construction approval, provided they meet every standard in the State Environmental Planning Policy (Exempt and Complying Development Codes) 2008. Larger work can need a complying development certificate or a development application. Read council approval for renovations in NSW for the detail.

What should I check before hiring a renovator in NSW?

Start with the contractor licence. In NSW a licence is needed for residential building work over $5,000 including GST, and for specialist work such as electrical, plumbing, gasfitting and air conditioning at any value. For work over $20,000 including GST, the builder must also provide home building compensation insurance before starting work or taking a deposit.

Can I talk directly to the tradesperson doing the work?

Yes. You speak with the people who will be on site, not a call centre. They walk you through what needs protecting, which trades come in when, and what to check before handover, so you always know who is in your home and why.

How does your pricing work?

For a clearly defined job, you get a fixed price in an itemised written quote that lists the scope, materials, inclusions and exclusions. For time-based work, we agree the hourly rate up front. If something outside the quote comes up, we explain the change and its cost before any extra work goes ahead.

What is the Masters price-beat promise?

If you have a current, itemised written quote for the same work, we will beat it by 5% on a like-for-like basis. The scope, materials, specifications, inclusions and terms must match, and we compare the total payable, including GST where applicable. Show us that quote before you accept ours.

Which parts of Sydney do you cover, and when are you open?

We work across Sydney and we are open six days a week. Add your suburb to the project planner below and we will confirm we can take on your job before booking a visit. Our Sydney service areas page lists the regions we cover.
